title: C2 fact supersession candidates (facts.candidate_fusion) dev comparison

sources.decision_rule: decideSingleFact: exact fingerprint duplicate, else the highest-cosine eligible candidate (same visibility, active) at or above the threshold supersedes; at 0.95 the real decideSingleFact runs beside the replay and must agree

comparisons.description: probes whose claim has an active row in both arms: that row is in the scored candidate set
probes whose decision replaced or deduplicated a row of a different claim
per company: share of every claim ever established that still has an active row after the replay
probes decided as the fixture expects

notes: Both arms replay the same seeded fixture on a fresh in-memory PGLite brain per arm and threshold, through the product's listSupersessionCandidates (single-prepare.ts). Only facts.candidate_fusion differs. A source passes when twin recall@5 is superior and both guards hold at every threshold; the gate is false supersession and preserved distinct claims, never recall alone. Statistics: pairedClusterStatistics (src/core/eval/paired-bootstrap.ts), cluster bootstrap over companies and cluster sign-flip p, Holm within each threshold. No model or network calls during the replay; the local embedding model runs once, free. Dev verdict: it cannot set a default.
